summary: The single branch autoreview found no actionable correctness or regression defects. Documentation claims are source-derived, historical content is preserved through compatibility targets, and the static explorer passed its interaction and responsive checks. Motion review found only a 140 ms transform transition with a custom responsive curve, pointer-gated hover, and reduced-motion handling.
residual_risks: Integration and end-to-end behavior backed by Postgres was not re-executed because no disposable vector/pg_trgm database was available; this documentation-only branch does not alter runtime code.
